intro.sr: Klijent može sam da pregleda i otkaže sopstveni budući termin iz svog naloga, bez potrebe da zove ili piše salonu.
intro.en: A customer can view and cancel their own upcoming appointment from their account, without having to call or message the salon.

prijava.sr: Klijent se prijavljuje na svoj nalog.
prijava.en: The customer logs into their account.

pregled-termina.sr: U delu „Moji termini” klijent vidi listu svojih zakazanih termina.
pregled-termina.en: In the "My appointments" section, the customer sees a list of their booked appointments.

otvaranje-detalja-termina.sr: Klikom na termin, klijent otvara njegove detalje - dugme za otkazivanje je vidljivo jer je termin dovoljno daleko u budućnosti.
otvaranje-detalja-termina.en: Clicking the appointment opens its details - the cancel button is visible because the appointment is far enough in the future.

otkazivanje-termina.sr: Klijent klikne „Otkaži termin”, potvrdi u dijalogu, i termin je otkazan.
otkazivanje-termina.en: The customer clicks "Cancel appointment", confirms in the dialog, and the appointment is cancelled.
